name: Relevance to Context
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the provided context and interesting fact.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the extent to which the response encourages further conversation and interaction.

name: Clarity
description: Evaluates the clarity and coherence of the response, ensuring it is easy to understand.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and creativity of the response, including the use of unique ideas or expressions.

name: Emotional Resonance
description: Assesses the emotional impact of the response and its ability to connect with the audience on an emotional level.

name: Grammar and Syntax
description: Evaluates the correctness of grammar, punctuation, and syntax in the response.
